disclaimer: Published rule sets over computed descriptors, plus RDKit's PAINS and Brenk structural alerts. No trained ADMET model is used anywhere in this project, so nothing here is a prediction of absorption, metabolism or toxicity — passing is clearing a filter, not an assay.
